headword: {反復練習|はんぷくれんしゅう}
gloss: drill practice; repetitive practice; repeated exercise

definitions.gloss: drill practice; repetitive practice; repeated exercise
definitions.explanation: A learning method based on performing the same action or exercise many times to build skill or commit something to memory. Commonly applied in education, music, sports, and language learning.

examples.japanese: {反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
ピアノは{反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}で{上達|じょうたつ}する。
{漢字|かんじ}を{覚|おぼ}えるには{反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}が{最|もっと}も{効果的|こうかてき}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that repetitive practice is the most effective way to learn kanji.

notes:
A compound of {反復|はんぷく} (repetition) and {練習|れんしゅう} (practice). Refers to a learning method based on repeating the same action many times to build skill or memory. Commonly used in education, music, sports, and language learning contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}をする: to do repetitive practice
- {反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}で{身|み}につける: to master through repetitive practice
- {反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す: to keep doing drills

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {繰|く}り{返|かえ}し{練習|れんしゅう} — repeated practice (more conversational)
- {基礎|きそ}{練習|れんしゅう} — basic practice; fundamental drills
- ドリル — drill (loanword, often used for workbook exercises)
